items.title: 基因序列預測模型AlphaGenome 2深入細胞層次，追查疾病相關DNA變異
items.summary: DeepMind發布基因序列預測模型AlphaGenome 2，能依不同細胞類型與狀態，預測DNA變異對基因表現的影響。前代模型主要分析組織整體的分子活動，新版則能辨識只在特定細胞中發揮作用的變異，協助研究人員追查疾病相關的基因調控機制。

items.title: fix(cli): let interrupted ID status checks exit promptly (#197747)
items.summary: fix(cli): let interrupted ID status checks exit promptly (#197747) fix(cli): stop id status Gateway requests when interrupted openclaw id status noticed Ctrl-C or SIGTERM but kept its Gateway status and people-link requests open. Under the normal launcher the command never stopped on its own and was killed with exit 137; without respawn it waited for the reply and could print the full report after the interrupt. Both requests now take the command's abort signal, and an abort after interrupt ends quietly with the existing interrupt exit code. Uninterrupted status, Gateway errors and rebind are unchanged. No new text. Evidence: the built CLI in a secretless node:24.22.1 container against a stand-in Gateway that holds the status reply for 30 s, plain and --json, SIGINT and SIGTERM, main twice and candidate twice. On main the launcher killed the command after 2-4 s with exit 137, and with OPENCLAW_NO_RESPAWN=1 it waited about 30 s and printed the report late in three of four runs. With this change every run exits within 1 s with 130 or 143 and prints only the existing interrupt line. Uninterrupted status in text and JSON, a key rotation through id rebind and a Gateway error are identical on both. Net test lines 0. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197747#issuecomment-6826386963. Thanks @Alix-007. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: Google同步更新Chrome 157穩定版、Chrome 156延伸穩定版與ChromeOS LTS版
items.summary: Google於11月11日同步發布Chrome瀏覽器及ChromeOS作業系統安全更新。其中在Chrome 157桌面穩定版方面，Windows與Linux平臺更新至157.0.8103.78版，macOS平臺更新至157.0.8103.79版，共修補83個漏洞，包含5個重大漏洞與78個高風險漏洞。在漏洞涉及的元件方面，以Skia與V8元件最多，各有17個。

items.title: OpenAI招募AI旅遊規畫平臺Odessia創辦人
items.summary: OpenAI將招募以AI輔助旅遊規畫平臺新創公司Odessia創辦人暨執行長，以強化線上旅遊服務能力。 Odessia執行長Francis Davidson本周透過X宣布這項消息。他的LinkedIn個人帳號職稱也已改成OpenAI旅遊部門。

items.title: 菲律賓證管會傳數位平臺被駭，逾40萬用戶資料外洩
items.summary: 菲律賓證券交易管理委員會（Securities and Exchange Commission，SEC）本週一（11月9日）傳出數位平臺被駭，導致駭客竊走超過40萬用戶姓名、使用者名稱及稅籍編號等資料並放上網兜售。菲國SEC已著手調查。
